description: Prospective v27 furnished-house trials. Eight rooms, 24x12 m, 3.2 m ceilings, 2.4 m tall doorways. Room-specific collidable furniture and supported inspection markers. Same Jev local controller and sensor limits as v26. Scene differences mean these are not matched controller-only comparisons.
strict_pass: Every inspection and return; zero contacts, movement-rule violations, false reports and audit problems.
